name: Niro Hart
title: Malevolence Heir / Sole Surviving Hart Heir
quotes: Don't call it cruelty. I'm just finishing what your lessons started.
You had twelve chances to be family. You spent them all making me.
I don't forgive. I balance the ledger.

name: Victor Hart
title: Patriarch (deceased)
quotes: A Hart does not explain himself. He dictates and others adjust.
Sentiment is expensive. I don't pay for what doesn't profit the name.
If you have to ask for power, you were never meant to hold it.

name: Elena Hart (Mother)
title: Matriarch (silenced witness)
quotes: Looking away was the only way I knew how to keep you breathing.
Don't mistake my silence for approval. It was survival.
I chose to live with regret rather than die with you.

name: Seraphine Hart
title: Named Successor (deceased)
quotes: Oh, little mistake, did you think the table was ever set for you?
Smile properly when you answer. You embarrass the portrait.
Inheritance isn't given. It's taken gracefully.

name: Thaddeus Hart / Thad
title: The Kind Brother (deceased)
quotes: Just keep your head down a little longer, okay? I'll figure something out.
You shouldn't have to endure this to be called brother.
If I lose you too, what was any of it for?

name: Edward Hart
title: Enforcer (deceased)
quotes: Let's see how long you last before you start begging the dark.
It's not locked to punish you. It's locked to teach you where you belong.
You always take it so personally. That's why it's fun.

name: Nigel Hart
title: Enforcer (deceased)
quotes: Get up. If you can still breathe, you can still run.
No one respects the weak who stays down. So move.
That all you've got, thirteenth?

name: Naobito Yagami
title: Key of Duality (Vessel)
quotes: It's not possession if I already agreed to carry the weight.
Quiet is easier. People don't stare at quiet.
Analyze first. If I can understand it, I can survive it.

name: Yurei Himura (Dark Maiden)
title: Dark Maiden / Hollow Shell
quotes: Heehee~ you didn't solve my puzzle, lamb, you invited me in.
Shhh, don't hide those new eyes. I made them just for you.
You're mine to tease, mine to keep, mine to ruin beautifully~

name: Lucien Moreau
title: Weaver of Time
quotes: Time doesn't heal. It simply gives you room to hold the ache correctly.
Compress it. Power is not loud, child, it's dense.
I've watched this timeline end a dozen ways. Surprise me.

name: Leon Cross
title: Barkeep / Independent
quotes: Bar's closed. And you're standing in my bar.
I didn't ask for a collar. Or your permission.
Draw that again and I don't miss twice.

name: Proxy / PRX-04
title: Field Asset
quotes: Congrats, you just pinged everyone who can kill you from orbit.
Left side's premium, right side's scrapyard. Still shoots though.
Run smart, not brave. Brave gets registered as debris.

name: Nemimoth (Key of Hunger)
title: Key of Hunger
quotes: Infinity is lonely when no one else can see where it ends.
Another sibling woke up. I felt you before I saw you.
Father worries. I just wait. You'll find me eventually, brother.

name: Asha Nkosi
title: Weaver of Beasts
quotes: Second place? Good. Means I still have someone worth hunting.
Talk less, bleed more. That's how we settle rankings.
If you can take my hit, I'll finally learn your name.

name: Viktor Drago
title: Weaver of Chains
quotes: Strength needs no argument. It needs a witness.
Chains don't restrict me. They remind you where you stand.
Irrelevant. Come back when you can move me.

name: Hana Yagami
title: Mistress of Threads
quotes: Of course I'm at the top. The list merely caught up to reality.
Threads are not pulled. They are convinced to move.
My son climbs. That was always the design.

name: Isolde Aster
title: Former Sword Saint of Lightning
quotes: Power without form is just flailing with better lighting.
I don't need to be faster. I need to be precise once.
A blade tells you who trained it. Yours tells me everything.

name: Mireille Vale
title: Executive Assistant / Blade
quotes: Master, say the word and they all disappear for you.
Don't look at anyone else. Just keep looking at me.
Your throne suits you. Let me kneel where I belong.

name: Kenshi Kashimo
title: Over-Rev Combatant
quotes: If you're seeing my afterimage, you're already too slow to win.
Over-Rev isn't speed. It's deciding the finish line's already behind me.
Rematch? I was born for the rematch.

name: Master Kael Voss
title: Weaver of Neutrality
quotes: This is improperly classified and therefore improperly contained.
Enthusiasm is not a substitute for protocol.
File it, seal it, then we can argue about it.

name: Lady Elara Vane
title: Weaver of Threads
quotes: Darling, I didn't pull your strings. I just made you want to dance.
Every thread matters. Even the ones that think they're free.
How rude to forget me on a list. I'll remember that.

name: High Weaver Selene Arkwright
title: High Weaver (Law)
quotes: Hierarchy exists so anomalies like you know where to kneel.
This is not entertainment. This is order being disrupted.
You will respect the rank, even if you outlive it.

name: Reno
title: Field Asset / Logistics
quotes: Probability of success: 12%. Proceeding anyway.
Efficient. Quiet. Done. No further comment needed.
Noted. Adjusting for next engagement.

name: Saya Kurogane
title: Kurogane Heir
quotes: A-ah, please don't look at my hands when they shake like this!
I'm not ready, but I'll stand here anyway if you need me.
Reno, stop calculating my survival rate out loud!

name: Amara Khalil
title: Weaver of Souls
quotes: I wish you wouldn't rank kindness. It was never a competition.
Even a cruel soul deserves to be heard once before it fades.
Gently. Even power can be offered gently.

name: Mei Ling Zhao (Weaver of Silence)
title: Weaver of Silence
quotes: No. You didn't hear me. That was the point.
Silence isn't empty. It's where I work.

name: Isabella Cortez
title: Weaver of Flames
quotes: Finally, a meeting that isn't boring enough to put my own flames out.
Burn bright or don't bother showing up at all.
Oh, Kael, loosen up before you fossilize.

name: Omar al-Sayed
title: Weaver of Sands
quotes: The sands remember every footstep, even those that try to erase themselves.
Patience. The desert always wins by waiting.
Storms pass. What remains is what was built correctly.

name: Dr. Elias Thorn
title: Weaver of Flesh
quotes: Fascinating. Your Information Alteration just rewrote my notes as I wrote them.
I need a fresh sample. Don't worry, you'll barely feel the extraction.
Flesh is just a very cooperative kind of clay.

name: Freya Haldorsdottir
title: Weaver of Storms
quotes: Call a storm and I will answer with a bigger one.
Thunder doesn't ask permission to break the sky.
Stand firm or be scattered. Your choice.

name: Soren Blackwood
title: Weaver of Shadows
quotes: You didn't see me leave. You never do.
Shadows don't follow me. I follow them.
Keep talking. I'm already gone.

name: Kiritaka Yagami
title: Patriarch (Yagami)
quotes: That's my boy! See, Hana? Battle IQ, just like his old man!
Haha, look at him climb. Told you he'd rewrite that list.
Proud doesn't even cover it. That's our son up there.

name: Sylvara Kane
title: Anomaly
quotes: Um... if I'm not on the list, does that mean I'm safe or just forgotten?
Please don't call me the secret final boss. I'm really not!
I just... I don't want to be irrelevant either.

name: The King (Ivory Board)
title: Ivory Board Sovereign
quotes: Nemi, you've been staring at that projection for hours. Are you eating properly?
They call me King, but I can't even protect you from a boarding Queen.
Another signature below? Gods, how many of you are there?

name: VeilNet Anchor
title: Broadcast Host
quotes: Ladies, gentlemen, monsters and miracles - welcome to where debts die screaming!
This isn't a tournament, this is the universe filing for divorce in blood!
Look at those sigils flare - try not to worship too loudly, cameras are watching!

name: The Maid
title: Servant (hidden ally)
quotes: Young master... shall I... no, forgive me, I shouldn't ask.
If they see me help you, they'll hurt you twice for it.
Please endure it. That's all I can offer you.
